description: This file defines the MenuScreen and MenuItemDetailScreen widgets for a Flutter app, displaying a list of menu items and their details including images, descriptions, allergens, and options to add items to a cart.

classes.name: MenuScreen
classes.description: A widget that displays a grid of menu items, allowing users to browse the menu.

classes.name: MenuItemDetailScreen
classes.description: A widget that shows detailed information about a selected menu item, with options to select portions, adjust quantity, and add to cart.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the MenuScreen or MenuItemDetailScreen, depending on the widget.
